profiles.scope: Brand-specific front-load or top-load washer cohorts only
checks: Stop the cycle and wait for the door/lid lock indicator to clear.

checks: Confirm dishes, handles, and utensils stay inside the rack envelope.

profiles.scope: Brand-specific full-size refrigerator cohorts, split by side-by-side and French-door topology
checks: Move food packages, bins, drawers, or shelves that block closure.
